description: Delegate an independent task to a subagent that runs in parallel. The brief must be self-contained. Returns a task id; collect the report with await_tasks.
name: spawn_agent

location.description: Restrict to models on this machine or at hosted providers

model.description: A model table id (or <endpoint>:<model>) to use

single_call.description: The subagent gets the brief and no tools, answers in exactly one model call, and its reply is the report. Use for hard, self-contained questions; put everything it needs in the brief. Default false.

tags.description: Labels such as code or vision that delegation rules match. Task classes route by default: refactor, tests, ui, format, docs prefer small local models; architecture, math, proof, algorithm, design prefer cloud frontier models.

tier.description: Minimum model capability; the cheapest suitable model is chosen. Default standard.
